d:
Now in HD! Official music video for "With Arms Wide Open" from Creed's iconic second album, Human Clay (1999).
Creed is celebrating the 25th anniversary of the band's Diamond-certified album Human Clay with a remastered and expanded deluxe reissue!
The hit album features the global smash hits “Higher,” “What If,” “Are You Ready?” & the GRAMMY-Winning, No.1 Single “With Arms Wide Open,” while the new deluxe edition adds rarities, B-sides, and a complete, previously-unreleased concert from 1999.
